title: Codex Deleted Its Own Context—and Kept Working
description:
A screen recording had flooded the working context, so Codex reached for Valo’s Context Trim by itself. The heavy video payload disappeared; the written diagnosis and the visible chat stayed intact.

Watch the full Valo update: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yNOUrpKMGbo
